description.value: Established in 2021, Pizzeria La Stella is an upscale Italian pizzeria in Nanaimo serving artisanal thin-crust and Sicilian-style pizzas made entirely from scratch — dough, dips, and house-cured pepperoni included. The restaurant sources locally where possible, partnering with Regard Coffee Roasters across the street and Farmship Growers Cooperative in Yellowpoint for fresh salad greens. Cyclists can dine in for a full three-course meal, grab a coffee and tiramisu at the counter, or call ahead for a pick-up order.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (504-6581 Aulds Road, Nanaimo, BC), phone (250.933.3301), and business identity. The website explicitly confirms pick-up/takeout service and lists multiple vegetarian and vegan menu items (Pomodoro Vegan, Margherita V, 3 Cheese V, Funghi V, Squash & Tomato V, Strawberry Sorbet Vegan). No bike-specific amenities, washroom mentions, or water refill information appear anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null. OSM opening_hours (We-Su 16:00-20:00) conflicts with the website, which shows Wed-Sun opening at noon.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag ('We-Su 16:00-20:00') conflicts with the website, which shows Wed-Sun opening at noon (12:00 P.M.) and closing at 8 or 9 P.M. The OSM hours appear outdated and should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and active menu. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a hot meal or takeout in Nanaimo.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Pick-up orders only. Available from open to close.' and 'Call us at 250.933.3301 to order take-out or make a reservation.' Delivery also available via DoorDash and SkipTheDishes

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian options marked (V): Margherita Traditional, 3 Cheese, Funghi, Squash & Tomato; vegan options marked explicitly: Pomodoro pizza and Strawberry Sorbet. No gluten-free options mentioned
